name: Rectangular Blocks
description: Adds rectangular blocks to the selected composition area.
prompt: Add rectangular blocks using {shape_density} density and {shape_color}. Arrange the blocks with varied sizes, spacing and positioning while keeping them visually clean and distinct. The blocks should remain behind and never obscure the primary subject or important information.

params.label: Shape
params.preview: Display a visual preview of rectangular blocks with varied proportions on a neutral background.

params.label: Density
params.preview: Display the approximate amount, spacing and visual coverage of rectangular blocks at the selected density.

params.label: Color
params.preview: Display the selected block color as a color swatch alongside the shape preview.

rules.instruction: Use a small number of widely separated rectangular blocks with substantial negative space.
Use a balanced number of rectangular blocks with varied sizes and moderate spacing.
Use many rectangular blocks with tighter spacing and greater visual coverage while keeping individual blocks distinguishable.
Keep all blocks rectangular with varied width and height. Do not transform them into circles, polygons or other shapes.
Do not allow blocks to distort, replace or obscure the primary subject or important visual information.
